factor_name: Cross-asset median reversal with dispersion damping (10d)

calculation.description: Ranks assets for reversal of their trailing 10-day return relative to the daily cross-sectional median. The relative reversal is damped in unusually dispersed cross-asset conditions and amplified in subdued-dispersion conditions. Inputs are shifted one completed day before use.

validation.regime_notes: 10d IC was negative in 2020-2027 (-0.02454 and -0.02229) and positive in 2028-2035 (0.05915 and 0.02832). Admission gates pass, but regime dependence and small 15-asset cross-section warrant conservative ensemble weight and monitoring.
